origin: Independent authored component laws and procedural parameters; no benchmark examples or source payloads
topology: Source and series resistor feed two return branches; the second return resistor is controlled by the switch
solver: Exact rational nodal KCL, independently checked by series/parallel reduction; no numeric tolerance or rounding
representations: novel component glyphs plus complete legend
family: Topology, switch state and normalized resistor ratios; voltage and render variations stay in the same family
gate: Requires independent render/rights/contamination and actual pinned processor approval before any training
